title: Advanced Professional Certificate in E-Commerce
description: The aim of this course is to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the principles and practices of E-commerce.
longDescription: The aim of this course is to provide students with a comprehensive introduction to E-commerce. By the end of this course, students will have a solid understanding of the fundamentals of E-commerce, allowing them to explore the world of online business with confidence and competence.
courseDetails: E-commerce infrastructure and elements of e-commerce infrastructure. The network infrastructure for e-commerce. Different types of e-commerce architecture. Broadband telecommunication. Mobile commerce, its types, its applications. Wireless application protocol. Mobile information device profile (midp). E-marketplaces, their types, key success factors of e-marketplace, features of e-marketplaces, and the impact of e-marketplaces on the economy. Compare Conventional Design and E-Organization. Understand E-commerce Enterprise’s Organizational Structure. Understand the concept and dynamics of E-Retailing. Understand and utilize a Conversion Funnel. Understand and apply the concept of E-services. Understand E-commerce Marketing and strategies with the help of case studies Grow Ecommerce by understanding the strategies and barriers to growth. Understand Competitive Advantage, Michael Porter & Sustainable Competitive Advantage. Understand and measure the success of a strategy with the help of cost-benefit analysis and ROI calculation techniques. Understand the process and Requirements of Starting an Online Business and measuring its impact. Understand and apply E-commerce Software systems. Understand E-commerce Websites, along with their types. Understand the concept of Supply Chain Management in E-commerce. Understand Product Sourcing, Strategic Sourcing, Outsourcing, and Offshoring in E-commerce. Understand What is an EFT Payment? And How Do e-Checks Work? Understanding Digital payment systems, currency and Payment Gateways. Understand E-commerce Security Fundamentals and deal with issues arising there. Understand and comply with E-commerce Business Laws and Regulations. Understand Ethics, Social and Political Issues. Learn about the Basic Ethical Concepts: Responsibility, Accountability and Liability. Understand Privacy and Information Rights. Understand What is Customer Data, the Importance of Collecting Customer Data, and Data Collection Methods. Understand the concept of E-Governance and its types. This course is designed to offer students a comprehensive overview of E-commerce, with the goal of ensuring they have a strong grasp of the fundamental concepts involved. By the conclusion of the course, students will have the knowledge and expertise necessary to confidently navigate the world of online business. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Introduction to E-commerce Management: Recognizing the Network Infrastructure of E-commerce and Mobile Commerce: Managing the E-enterprise: Realizing E-Business Strategy and Implementation: Appraising E-commerce Software System: Recognizing the Legal and Security Framework of E-commerce:
